name: CKEditor Remove Div
description: Adds a "Remove Div" plugin to CKEditor 5 (unwrap/remove <div> containers).
project_description:
Overview 
 The CKEditor RemoveDiv module offers a straightforward solution for managing div elements in CKEditor, Drupal's default WYSIWYG editor. This module simplifies the content editing experience by allowing users to effortlessly remove div elements directly from the text editor, without needing to access the HTML source mode.

 Why Use CKEditor RemoveDiv? 
 Managing divs can be cumbersome, especially for editors who prefer to avoid diving into HTML. Traditionally, removing these elements required switching to "Source" mode and manually editing the HTML, a process both tedious and error-prone. The CKEditor RemoveDiv module streamlines this task, providing a simple button that removes the div containing the cursor or its nearest parent div, converting it to a paragraph to maintain valid HTML structure.

 Key Features 
 
 Easy Div Removal: Removes div elements with a single click. 
 Maintains HTML Structure: Converts divs to paragraphs to ensure valid HTML. 
 Seamless Integration: Works directly within the CKEditor interface. 
 
 Installation & Configuration 
 
 Navigate to Configuration > Content Authoring > CKEditor. 
 Edit the CKEditor profile where you want to enable the RemoveDiv button. 
 Add the RemoveDiv button to the desired toolbar configuration. 
 Save the changes.
